items.title: Lee Paige Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: Weren't you influenced quite a bit by the records of Bessie Smith and also Fats Waller? ... I have quite a bit of his records and I always liked his style of singing and I think he was a wonderful piano player.

ctx.x: Well, some of the boogie woogie numbers was Cow Cow Boogie and Pig Foot Pete and Beat Me Daddy Eight to the Bar and Scrubbing Me Mama with a Boogie Brush and numbers of that sort.
Lee, didn't you used to listen a lot? Weren't you influenced quite a bit by the records of Bessie Smith and also Fats Waller? Did you used to hear Fats sing?

Oh yes, I have quite a bit of his records and I always liked his style of singing and I think he was a wonderful piano player. I liked his style of playing and his style of singing. I do a lot of his numbers called Why Am I Neglected and Honey Keep Your Mind On Me and Honeysuckle Rose and all those numbers that he did. I liked his style. And Bessie Smith, I do her first number that she ever recorded. I have the original music on it and I sing it. It's called Golf Coast Blues, which is a popular number today and…
